user.title: Sign in to E-Distribuzione
user.description: Use the same credentials as the official E-Distribuzione app or website. After signing in you will be asked for an OTP code, received by email or SMS: it will be sent by this setup, do not use codes generated on the website or in the app. If you have the app or the website open, log out there first: E-Distribuzione limits the number of concurrent sessions per account.{pod_correnti}

otp.title: OTP code
otp.description: Enter the OTP code you received by email or SMS. {avviso}

data.richiedi_nuovo_codice: Request a new code (leave the field above empty)

pod.title: Select POD
pod.description: You can select more than one POD if you want to monitor several of them with this same setup.

error.invalid_otp: Wrong or expired OTP code. It must be the code sent by this setup: one generated on the website or in the app belongs to another login session and is always rejected.
error.otp_mancante: Enter the OTP code, or tick "Request a new code" to have a new one sent
error.troppe_sessioni: E-Distribuzione refused the login because the account has too many concurrent sessions open. Log out of the official app and website, wait a few minutes and try again: in this state no OTP code is sent.
error.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.

abort.no_pods_found: No POD found for this account
abort.supplies_failed: Unexpected error while retrieving the PODs from the account. Start the setup again from the beginning (login and OTP included).
abort.otp_exchange_failed: The OTP code was accepted but completing the login failed. Start the setup again from the beginning (login and OTP included).
abort.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.

tipo_pod.title: Meter type per POD
tipo_pod.description: A+/A- describe what E-Distribuzione measures (consumption/injection): both are always fetched for every POD. The type below only describes the role of that meter in your system, and only changes the names shown in the Energy Dashboard. You can change it at any time, no new import needed.

aggiungi_pod.title: Add POD
aggiungi_pod.description: PODs currently configured: {pod_correnti}. Below are the ones available on your account that are not yet part of this setup.

rimuovi_pod.title: Remove POD
rimuovi_pod.description: Select the PODs to remove. Historical data already imported into the external statistics is not deleted.

orario.title: Request time
orario.description: Local hour (0-23) from which to request the previous day's curve. Current: {ora_attuale}:00.

error.non_puoi_rimuoverli_tutti: You cannot remove all PODs from here: remove the integration itself if you want to empty it completely

abort.nessun_pod: There are no configured PODs to remove
abort.nessun_pod_selezionato: Select at least one POD to add
abort.nessun_pod_da_aggiungere: All the PODs on your account are already configured here
abort.refresh_failed: Unable to renew access to E-Distribuzione. Try again later; if the problem persists a new login may be needed (remove and set up the integration again).
abort.supplies_failed: Unexpected error while retrieving the PODs from the account. Try again later.
abort.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.

recupera_storico.name: Fetch history
recupera_storico.description: Requests both energy directions (consumption and injection) for a past period from E-Distribuzione and imports them, with a single request per direction for the whole period (confirmed to work for up to 181 days in one response). History is not fetched automatically: you decide when and how much to fetch. For longer periods, repeat the action over consecutive ranges.

device_id.name: Setup / POD
device_id.description: Choose the device to fetch history for. The "E-Distribuzione" (account) device fetches all the PODs of the setup together; a single POD's device limits the fetch to that POD.

data_da.name: Start date
data_da.description: First day of the period to fetch.

data_a.name: End date
data_a.description: Last day of the period to fetch. Data is available with a one-day delay, so yesterday at the latest.

configura_energy_dashboard.name: Configure Energy Dashboard
configura_energy_dashboard.description: Adds the statistics of all configured PODs to the Energy Dashboard, according to the role assigned to each one (exchange -> grid source, production -> solar source). Idempotent action: it does not overwrite or duplicate sources that already exist (including those configured by hand), safe to run again after adding a POD or changing a role.

dispositivo_senza_configurazione.message: The selected device does not belong to any active setup.

pod_non_configurato.message: POD '{pod}' is not configured on this instance. Configured PODs: {pods}.

date_invertite.message: The start date ({data_da}) is after the end date ({data_a}).

data_fine_troppo_recente.message: The end date ({data_a}) is too recent: data is currently assumed to be available with at least a one-day delay, so up to {ultimo_utile} at the latest.

intervallo_troppo_ampio.message: A range of {giorni} days is too wide for a single request (courtesy limit: {massimo} days, about 6 months). Repeat the action over shorter periods.

nessun_dato_importato.message: No data imported for the period {data_da} - {data_a}. {dettagli}

errore_import_pod.message: Error importing the period for POD {pod}: {errore}

accesso_bloccato.message: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check. Consumption data will update again as soon as access is available.

accesso_bloccato.title: E-Distribuzione is blocking automated access
accesso_bloccato.description: E-Distribuzione answers with an anti-bot check instead of granting access, so the integration cannot renew it and consumption data does not update. It does not depend on your setup or credentials, and the data already imported is kept. The integration retries on its own every hour and this notice disappears as soon as access is available again.
